description: This file defines an Angular standalone component for a note form, enabling users to create or edit notes with a title and content. It includes inputs for an existing note, outputs for save and cancel actions, and methods to handle initialization, saving, and canceling.

classes.name: NoteFormComponent
classes.description: An Angular component allowing users to input or edit a note's title and content, with save and cancel functionalities.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component's title and content fields based on the provided note input.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Emits the save event with the current note data if title or content is not empty.

methods.name: cancelEdit
methods.description: Emits the cancel event to abort editing.
